answers.goal: I love film and TV in the most typical standard way and while loving it, noticed the lack of Black Americans in it. While it’s not the main thing on my mind everytime I watch something, it’s definitely a factor. I want to join my peers to bring more representation to people of color who are in this sector but also viewers.
answers.drew: The way it involves almost every aspect of a persons life. We seek entertainment everywhere and there are people making and creating all of it. It’s such an impactful experience and career.
answers.seeking: I’m looking forward to connecting with people of color in the industry, screenwriters, directors. I want to talk with people that are really passionate about their craft.
answers.inspiration: My biggest inspiration is Mara Brock Akil. She has had such an impact on Black television and is spectacular at it! Also, LA born like me! Overall, she’s such an incredible artist that makes me feel like there is truly a chance that I can make something that matters.
answers.favorite: Movie: Sorry, Baby Show: Living Single
